### The Fall of Babylon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fall-babylon
Passage: Jeremiah 50:11-12
Points:
- God sovereignly accomplishes His purposes through human desires without forcing people against their will.
- Babylon conquered Judah to advance its own power and glory rather than out of devotion to the Lord.
- Because Babylon acted with evil intent and gloated over plundering God's heritage, God justly judged the empire.
- Foretelling Babylon's downfall offered comfort, hope of restoration, and warning to the Jewish exiles.
- The prosperity of the wicked is only temporary and never signals God's favor or pleasure.
